q: Who runs the database of all .com names?
why: Registrars sell names; the registry runs the TLD.

q: Which record points a name at an IPv6 address?
why: A is IPv4, AAAA is IPv6.

q: Why can't the apex (example.com) be a CNAME?
o: It must also hold SOA/NS records, and a CNAME can't coexist with other records
